title: feat(app-shell): search on the Studio landing, the palette lists packages, objects and flows (objectui#11863, Q2)
body:
Fixes #11863
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

Q2 of objectui#11863, search on the Studio landing, as ruled in retriage `6054672824` ("Q2 → A, with C as the fallback if no read lists flows across packages"). A read that lists flows across packages exists, so this builds A with flows. Q1 (PR #12004) and Q3 (PR #11996) have landed; Q2 is the card's last ruled item.

- `StudioLanding` (`apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`) mounts `CommandPaletteProvider` and `CommandPalette scope="studio"`. Under the provider, the `studio` header draws its Search trigger through objectui#11912's existing rule, and `Ctrl+K` / `⌘K` opens the palette. `AppHeader`'s rule is unchanged; only its comment now names the `/studio` mount.
- `CommandPalette` gets a declared second scope. `scope="studio"` takes no other prop: there is no active app, so the scope has no app navigation group, no record search, no app switching, and no full-search command (its link is `/apps/APP/search`). It lists three Studio groups instead:
  - **Packages**: `fetchPackages`, the list the landing and its switcher read (kernel packages already left out). Each opens `/studio/PKG/data`, as a landing card does.
  - **Objects**: `useMetadata().objects`, each under the package it declares (`_packageId`), opened at `/studio/PKG/data?surface=object:NAME`. An object whose package is not in the list, or that has no package, has no Studio page and is left out.
  - **Flows**: the metadata cache's `flow` list, opened at `/studio/PKG/automations?surface=flow:NAME`. A flow that belongs to no package opens in the package-less scope, `/studio/~org/automations?surface=flow:NAME` (`studioOrgScopePath`, objectui#11553).
- Entries match on label or machine name through `matchesPaletteQuery`, the rule the palette's other entries use (objectui#11812). An object or packaged flow shows its package's name on the right. Nothing is read until the palette opens. The theme commands and the recently viewed records stay.
- Two pack rows in all ten packs: `console.commandPalette.packages` and `console.commandPalette.flows`. The objects group reuses `console.commandPalette.objects`.
- Docs: `packages/app-shell/README.md` (the palette section) and `content/docs/guide/console.md` (a "Search in Studio" row). Changeset `.changeset/11863-studio-search.md`. The pending Q1 changeset `.changeset/11863-studio-header.md` gains one append-only dated note (patch round 1, see Acceptance notes).

## Contract face (Clause-② yes, widening)

- `@object-ui/app-shell`, `CommandPalette` props: a second form, `scope="studio"`, which takes no other prop. The in-app form (`apps`, `activeApp`, `objects`, `onAppChange`, optional `dataSource`) is unchanged and still required; it leaves `scope` out. The props type is not exported by name. No export is added or removed. The scope is declared, not inferred from a missing `activeApp`. A type pin in the new test holds both directions: `CommandPalette scope="studio" activeApp=...` and a bare `CommandPalette` are compile errors. The pins are two `@ts-expect-error` lines that the package's `type-check` (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) compiles.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: the exported `en` pack and `TranslationKeys` gain `console.commandPalette.packages` and `console.commandPalette.flows`. Nothing is removed.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` minor, `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `@object-ui/console` patch. That follows the Q3 changeset's precedent for added pack rows. No major.

## The PM hypotheses, measured

- **H1, held** on `049012b`. `CommandPaletteProvider` was mounted only in `ConsoleLayout`. `AppHeader` asks `useCommandPaletteProviderMounted()`. In the reverse leg below, base `StudioRoute.tsx` gives "Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="action:command-palette:open"]" on `/studio`. So this card mounts the palette itself.
- **H2, held.** The clean shape mounts in `StudioLanding` only, not above Home, Organizations or AI. In a real browser, `/home` still draws 0 desktop and 0 compact triggers on this branch. Nothing was widened or narrowed silently.
- **H3, held** on `049012b`. A scratch probe (deleted, never committed) put the base `CommandPalette` (blob `77b85897`) at `/studio` with `apps` empty and `activeApp` null. The query `search` rendered the full-search item, and picking it went to `/apps/undefined/search`: 1 passed. This branch drops that command and every app-scoped group in the `studio` scope, by declaration.
- **H4: a cross-package flow read exists, so A, not C.** The metadata cache's `getItemsByType('flow')` is the unscoped `GET /api/v1/meta/flow`. It is the same unscoped list that `loadPackageLessSurfaces` narrows, and that function's doc says "The unscoped list also carries every PACKAGED item". On the server, `getMetaItems({ type })` with no package returns every package's items. The URL shapes come from `StudioDesignSurface`'s routing on `main`: `PILLAR_FOR_SURFACE_TYPE` (object to `data`, flow to `automations`), the `?surface=TYPE:NAME` deep link (`DESIGNER_SURFACE_PARAM`, `formatSurfaceParam`) and `studioOrgScopePath`. These were checked against a mocked API in the browser. I did not check them against a live objectstack server, because the sibling checkout is not installed or built in this container.
- **H5, fits.** Eager closure under the lock: base `049012b` is 3,238,404 B ("3162.5 KB gzipped across 289 of 2474 chunks (budget: 3204.6 KB, headroom: 42.1 KB)"). Branch `dbca37f` is 3,239,095 B ("3163.2 KB gzipped across 289 of 2474 chunks (budget: 3204.6 KB, headroom: 41.4 KB)"). The delta is +691 B, under the 3,281,467 ceiling, which was not touched. The bytes land in the `index` chunk (+770 B). `packages-io` was already in the eager `PackagesPage` chunk on base, so `fetchPackages` adds no module. `i18n-locale-en` grows 45,231 to 45,241 B, under its own ceiling. `b6a003e` changes one test docstring after `dbca37f`, with no source change.
- **H6.** `console.commandPalette.objects` fits the objects heading and is reused. No row in `packages/i18n` fits "Packages" or "Flows" as a group heading: `common.package` and `packagedAutomation.colFlow` are singular, and `console.studio.title` is the product name. The designer table (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) has `engine.packages.title`, but the palette reads only `packages/i18n` through `useObjectTranslation`. So the PR adds two rows in all ten packs.

## Verification (head `b6a003e`)

- **Union**, every test file that imports or names `CommandPalette`, `CommandPaletteProvider`, `AppHeader`, `StudioRoute` or `commandPalette` (`git grep -l`, 59 files), under `os-verify-lock`: "Test Files 59 passed (59)", "Tests 515 passed (515)".
- `packages/i18n/`: "Test Files 82 passed (82)", "Tests 1316 passed | 13 skipped (1329)".
- `scripts/__tests__/`: "Test Files 179 passed | 2 skipped (181)", "Tests 5452 passed | 2 skipped (5454)".
- **Type-check**: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`, all three script names echoed, exit 0. This ran after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'`.
- **New tests:** `CommandPalette.studioScope-11863.test.tsx` has 10 cases: groups and exclusions, each target URL, matching, no app-scoped entry plus an app-scope CONTROL, nothing read while closed plus a CONTROL. `StudioRoute.searchPalette-11863.test.tsx` has 4 cases through the real `studioRoutes`: both triggers, click, `Ctrl+K`, and picking a package opens its builder. The 11912 pin's CONTROL now includes `studio` under a provider.
- **Reverse verification**, from committed `dbca37f`. `CommandPalette.tsx` and `StudioRoute.tsx` were swapped to their base blobs (`77b85897`, `9e2098ca`; anchors `useStudioPaletteEntries` 1 to 0 and `scope="studio"` 1 to 0). The run gave "Tests 13 failed | 8 passed (21)". Red: the 9 studio-scope cases (the base palette throws "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')" with no app props) and the 4 route cases (no trigger). Green: the app-scope CONTROL and the 7 cases of the 11912 pin. The trap restored both files from `HEAD`: blobs `05643164`, `b314334d` equal `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Gates**, exit 0 each: `check:i18n-keys` ("Every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack (3313 keys)"), `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; neither new key listed), `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `check:control-bytes`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:test-path-roots`. Also exit 0: `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; `11806-login-server-unreachable.md` names `packages/app-shell/README.md` for its sign-up table, which this PR leaves alone), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check-changeset-presence` ("17 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)") and `check-changeset-no-major`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 20 paths says NOT GOVERNED.
- **eslint**: `--no-inline-config --format json` over the 17 changed ts/tsx files gives 0 errors. Each of the 5 edited files has the same warning count as its base blob through `--stdin`: 2, 13, 22, 11 and 13. The two new test files have 0. The population is the config's `**/*.{ts,tsx}` and the file count comes from the JSON output. The config is not type-aware (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

- **Patch round 1, head `12f3f09`.** One commit, changeset text only: `.changeset/11863-studio-header.md`, 2 lines added and 0 removed. At that head, exit 0 each: `check-changeset-presence` ("17 source file(s) of 3 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims` (report-only, the same 11806 reading as above), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes` and `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"). The union, type-check, eslint, bundle and browser readings in this section are from `b6a003e` and `dbca37f` and were not re-run: no source or test file changed. The two bot comments on this PR were read: the changeset-claim re-read (6077690455) names `.changeset/11806-login-server-unreachable.md` for `packages/app-shell/README.md`, and its paragraph is about the sign-up table, which this PR leaves alone, so it still holds; the CI Console Performance Budget on `b6a003e` (6077731629) reads PASS, 3163.4 KB against 3204.6 KB.

### Real browser (Chromium `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, 1440x900, `vite preview` of the `dbca37f` build on a private port, API mocked with `page.route`; `pageErrors` empty)

| Where | What was read |
|---|---|
| `/studio` | desktop trigger 1, compact 1; click gives `/studio?palette=1` |
| palette, empty query | headings Packages, Objects, Flows, Preferences; Acme CRM, People; Account (Acme CRM), Employee (People); Onboard Account (Acme CRM), Nightly Cleanup; three theme commands. Kernel package, `sys_user` and the kernel flow absent |
| query `search` | 0 items: no full-search command, nothing under `/apps/` |
| query `employee`, picked | `/studio/com.acme.hr/data?surface=object%3Ahr_employee` |
| `Ctrl+K` on `/studio`, package-less flow picked | `/studio?palette=1`, then `/studio/~org/automations?surface=flow%3Aorg_cleanup` |
| CONTROL `/apps/crm_app` | triggers 1 and 1; headings Objects, Preferences, Actions; `search` gives the full-search command |
| `/home` (untouched frame) | triggers 0 and 0 |

## Acceptance notes

- The pending `.changeset/11863-studio-header.md` (Q1) ends its first paragraph with "No command palette is mounted on `/studio`, so the header shows no search trigger there." This PR makes that sentence false. Patch round 1 leaves the sentence as written and appends one dated note after its paragraph, in the objectui#6152 round-12 shape: from objectui#11863 Q2 (this PR) the landing mounts the command palette in its `studio` scope, so the header draws the search trigger and `⌘K` opens it. This PR's own changeset also states the reversal in its first paragraph.
- Bounds, by design and stated in the code: objects and flows are the published items from the metadata cache, so an item that exists only as a draft is not listed. If the package read fails, the packaged entries are left out, and the landing under the palette shows that read's error.
- The pillar builder (`/studio/PKG/TAB`) mounts no palette. It is `StudioDesignSurface`'s full-screen frame, which this claim does not hold.
